people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Hur
people.line: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
translations.bsb: Joshua did as Moses had instructed him and fought against the Amalekites, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
translations.kjv: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
translations.asv: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
